p: For through the anger of the: So the Lord punished sin by sin and gave him up to his rebellious heart, till he had brought the enemy on him to lead him away and his people.
way of the gate between the: Read Jer 39:4.
where he gave judgment upon him: Read 2Ki 25:6, Jer 39:5.
tenth day of the month: In 2Ki 25:8 is it called the seventh day, because the fire began then and so continued to the tenth.
served the king of Babylon: That is, who was his servant, as in 2Ki 25:8.
pillars of brass that were in: Of these pillars read 1Ki 7:15.
shovels: Which were also made of brass, as in 1Ki 7:45.
weight: It was so much in quantity.
hundred on all sides: But because of the roundness, no more could be seen but ninety-six.
the second priest: Which served in the high priests stead, if he had any necessary impediment.
seven men of them that were: In 2Ki 25:19 is read but of five: those were the most excellent and the other two, which were not so noble are not there mentioned with them.
seventh year three thousand Jews and: Which was the latter end of the seventh year of his reign and the beginning of the eighth.
eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he carried: To the latter end also of that year, and the beginning of the nineteenth.
lifted up the head of Jehoiachin: That is, restored him to liberty and honour.
garments: And gave him princely apparel.

continual diet given him of the: That is he had allowance in the court, and thus at length he had rest and quietness because he obeyed Jeremiah the Prophet, while the others were cruelly ordered that would not obey him.
